findings.highlight: she is a good person even if she may look evil
findings.evidenceJa: 悪ぶっているように見えるが根は善人だ
findings.governingReading: she may act like a bad person, but she is good at heart
findings.explanation: Issei’s perceptive distinction between a cultivated bad-girl pose and underlying goodness becomes a claim about evil appearance.

findings.evidenceJa: ゼンマイ仕掛けの人形
findings.explanation: A familiar mechanical simile becomes an unnatural object description.

findings.evidenceJa: ナイフを持った一成を見る
findings.governingReading: I look at Issei holding a knife
findings.explanation: The sight that identifies Issei as the attacker is omitted from the prose.

findings.highlight: My brain that wants to deny the scene
findings.governingReading: More than death from blood loss, my brain, desperate to deny the scene
findings.explanation: The explicit comparison between physical death and psychological refusal disappears.
